name: shuffle-stop
description: Right 12, coast to a stop, left 12, coast again — a there-and-back that stays well inside level 0. Replaces the original clamp-left fixture, which walked far enough LEFT that the real game loaded an adjacent level (the recorded oracle showed level=94 at tick 61): the world clamp at x=2 is not reachable in level 0 because a room transition fires first, so no valid v1 tape can exercise it. The clamp is still transcribed and still covered, by the hand-derived unit case in playerPhysicsV1.test.js. This tape instead pins two full accelerate/decelerate cycles and a signed velocity reversal through zero.
